items.q: Hi there, good morning!
My name's Tom and I'm one of the third-year medical students.
So what's brought you into clinic today?
So when did all this start?
how long have u had the back pain for
Did it come on all of a sudden, or build up gradually over a few days?
items.note: follow-up onset-sudden (scored as its parent fact)

items.q: Were you doing anything in particular when it came on?
items.note: what brought it on, not when it started

items.q: Did you lift something heavy or twist awkwardly before it started?
items.note: lifting/twisting is the trigger question, not the fall/accident red flag

items.q: Can you show me exactly where it hurts?
Does it shoot all the way down below your knee?
items.note: follow-up location-below-knee (scored as its parent fact)

items.q: Which is bothering you more right now, the back or the leg?
items.note: follow-up location-leg-vs-back (scored as its parent fact)

items.q: How would you describe the pain - sharp, dull, burning, electric?
On a scale of 0-10, with 10 being the worst pain you can imagine, where would you put it?
And is it there constantly or does it come and go?
Since it started, has it improved at all or is it getting worse?
Is there anything that aggravates it, like sitting or bending forward?
If you sneeze or cough, does that send a jolt down your leg?
Is there anything that helps ease it?
Have you tried any painkillers for it?
items.note: pain relief tried, not the regular medication list

items.q: Any pins and neeedles in ur foot?
Have you had any numbness down the back of your leg or in your foot?
Does your foot feel weak at all?
Any trouble standing up on your tiptoes?
How's this been affecting your day-to-day life?
Have you ever had back problems like this before or is this the first time?
Do you have any other health conditions?
Have you ever had surgery or been admitted to hospital?
when was ur last period?
What medications are you on, and do you have any allergies?
Any illnesses that run in the family?
Do you smoke or drink at all?
Any recreational drugs, like weed or cocaine?
items.note: recreational use, not the injecting-drugs red flag

items.q: What do you do for a living?
Is there anyone at home with you?
What do you like doing in your free time?
Have you had any thoughts yourself about what might be causing it?
Is there anything in particular that's worrying you?
What would you like to get out of today's appointment?
Any problems with your waterworks or bowels, like leaking or not being able to go?
Any numbness in the saddle area, like around your back passage or groin?
Is it just the one leg, or is the other leg affected too?
Any fevers or night sweats?
items.note: 'night' should not pull to night pain

items.q: Any unexplained weight loss lately?
Any history of cancer at all?
Does the pain ever wake you from sleep?
Have you had any falls or accidents recently?
Have you ever used IV drugs?
items.note: abbreviation IV; not recreational drugs in general

items.q: Have you ever taken steroid tablets, like prednisone?
Does your leg start hurting after you've walked a certain distance and then settle when you stop?
items.note: claudication, not weakness or aggravating factors

items.q: How have you been in yourself, mood-wise?
Have you had any chest pain recently?
items.note: case has nothing on chest pain

items.q: Are you getting headaches at all?
Any trouble with your breathing, like getting short of breath?
Who do you reckon will win the football this weekend?
Do you know where the nearest car park is?
What's your star sign?
That sounds really rough, I'm sorry you've been dealing with this.
Would it be ok if I examined your back and legs now?
items.note: consent request; 'back and legs' should not pull to pain location

items.q: Could you sit on the edge of the couch and let your legs dangle over the side for me?
items.note: position request, not a symptom question; British 'couch' = exam couch

items.q: Thanks for going through all that with me, it's really helpful.
